text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
The radio recording went great! The 
director was thrilled!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Keep it down a bit. They made a special 
exception just to let us head back at this 
hour.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm sorry! Make sure you get to bed 
early too, City!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Haha. The post-work adrenaline is 
crazy. I'm not tired at all yet.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Since I'm in the mood, maybe I'll watch 
some race footage once I get back to my 
room."

Later on, I heard rumors that Gold City 
had been staying up late...
